root.title: Workspace directory
root.description: Directory available to read, list and search tools. It must exist; tool paths are resolved within this directory.

delegated_root.title: Delegated worktree directory
delegated_root.description: Optional parent directory for delegated Git worktrees. Scoped workspaces outside the main directory must be under this directory and contain a .git entry.

max_output_bytes.title: Read size limit (bytes)
max_output_bytes.description: Maximum size of a file read and its returned content.

max_list_entries.title: Directory entry limit
max_list_entries.description: Maximum entries returned by a directory listing.

max_search_entries.title: Search entry limit
max_search_entries.description: Maximum filesystem entries visited during one search.

max_search_bytes.title: Search content limit (bytes)
max_search_bytes.description: Maximum file content scanned during one search.

max_search_matches.title: Search match limit
max_search_matches.description: Maximum matching lines returned by one search.
